paragraphs: Scylla sells software that reads video from cameras and turns what it sees into insights about activity and objects. Suspicious content is checked in real time by a decision-making algorithm the company calls Charon, and the result goes to alerting protocols. Alerts go to security response units over web and mobile channels with a screenshot and the location and time of the incident.

Detection products cover firearms, identification of specific individuals such as suspects or persons of interest, and shoplifting events. One product detects persons or vehicles in a specific zone at a specified time. An edge device delivers the video analytics out of the box. Scylla AI integrates with existing VMS and cameras and filters out false alarms.
A channel partner program gives distributors and integrators support to deliver Scylla AI solutions to their customers. The company states its mission as creating AI tech for video surveillance.

quote.text: At Scylla, our mission is to create the best possible AI tech for video surveillance
